items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And I had the other cousins that were like Louise Jones.

ctx.x: But now, we was kept away on my mother's side, going back to my cousins. Now, they all sang and played. And I had the other cousins that were like Louise Jones. Her husband -- she and her husband were both great musicians. And her son, Paris Jones, was the one that Kenny Dorham actually learned from. They were like brothers. And when Diz came to Texas, he'd always look for my second cousin, Paris Jones
